output.subject: We've received your complaint about duplicate fees
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us, and for following up by email. We have received your complaint.

You told us that on 9/8 your $425 Bellwether Insurance autopay came through when your checking balance was short, and you were charged a $34 fee, which you said you accept. You mentioned that the same payment was then returned and presented again on 9/10/2026, and that you were charged a second $34 fee, making $68 in fees for one payment. You've asked for the second fee to be refunded.

You also told us that you first raised this through the complaint form on our website on 9/15/2026 and haven't heard back. We understand how frustrating it is to wait without a reply, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused. We've noted that you'd like to hear from us this week and that you are considering moving your accounts.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond within 10 business days.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer wants a reply this week; the draft only commits to 10 business days, so decide whether faster contact is possible.
Customer is threatening to move accounts to a credit union; consider retention handling.
Find the 9/15/2026 web form submission and confirm why it went unanswered.
Verify the 9/8 and 9/10/2026 fee postings and whether the second fee relates to the same $425 payment.
Customer explicitly accepts the first $34 fee and disputes only the second one.
Decide on the refund request; the draft makes no commitment either way.
Sign-off name is 'J. ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧'; confirm the greeting format is appropriate.
